description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart labeled “Task Type” that shows the distribution of task types in the study, with three slices in total. The largest slice is labeled “Article generation” and is colored salmon/red, occupying roughly about 83% of the ring (its exact percentage is not printed on the slice). A medium slice on the right is colored light blue and labeled “Article editing (14.6%).” A very small slice near the lower right is colored pale yellow and labeled “Headline generation (2.4%).” The chart uses direct text labels outside the ring (including percentages for two categories), has no separate legend, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized beyond their size; the slices appear arranged with the largest segment spanning most of the left and top portions of the donut.
